catch_copy: The cutest, toughest girls' TPS is here! A smoke grenade lights up a neon-drenched city, and the Cutie Squad charges in to save the day!
description:
Bursting onto the scene with stunning cartoon rendering and cel-shading technology, Cutie Squad: Crime War delivers a uniquely charming anime-style action experience like no other! In a sprawling modern metropolis lit up by glittering neon lights and towering skyscrapers, a powerful criminal cartel known as "Black Mamma" is tightening its grip on the city. Using cutting-edge hacking technology and illegally armed forces, they scheme to seize control of the city's financial networks and energy infrastructure. As the last police barricades crumble under their overwhelming firepower, a bright pink smoke grenade suddenly bounces into the centre of the chaos. Out of the billowing smoke steps the leader of the Cutie Squad, wearing a cool smile and a police tactical uniform, her purple bob hair swaying with every confident stride. Meet Yuna! "Today's shopping trip is cancelled. Looks like I've got a city to clean up instead!"

・Race through thrilling stages from the glitzy financial district to Black Mamma's secret underground fortress, full of heart-pounding missions and non-stop action!
・Spend the Gold you earn from clearing stages to collect Yuna's adorable and one-of-a-kind costume collection!
・Every costume you unlock comes with an exclusive original wallpaper themed around that outfit. The joy of collecting has never felt so rewarding!
・Enter the SHOW Mode for any collected costume and discover yet another hidden original wallpaper. You won't be able to take your eyes off the screen!
・Tap on Yuna to unlock her hidden charms, from bright and bubbly reactions to the most endearingly bashful responses!
・Use the Character Viewer Mode to admire your collected costumes from every angle and enjoy Yuna's irresistible cuteness to your heart's content!
・When the Cutie Squad logo blazes across the city's billboard, the curtain rises on the grand finale. An ending only those who complete every story chapter will ever see! The shocking truth behind Black Mamma and a secret only Yuna knows will finally come to light!

Beneath that adorable smile lies an unstoppable fighting spirit, and Yuna's action-packed mission to save the city starts now! Explosive action that shakes the city to its core, an irresistibly cute costume collection, the thrill of unlocking hidden wallpapers, gallery collectibles, and a jaw-dropping ending story. It's all here! A brand-new evolution of the visual-style TPS, packed with cuteness, firepower, and non-stop personality. Join the Cutie Squad, the cutest and toughest crew in the city, and save the day right now!

Prologue
A gleaming modern metropolis, alive with neon lights and soaring skyscrapers. On the surface, it looks vibrant and peaceful, but in the shadows, the criminal cartel known as "Black Mamma" is quietly squeezing the life out of the city. Armed with cutting-edge hacking tools and illegal forces, they have set their sights on seizing the city's key financial networks and energy infrastructure. The police don't stand a chance against their overwhelming firepower.

Then, right in the middle of the panicking crowd, a bright pink smoke grenade goes pop! Through the swirling haze comes the click of high heels on concrete. Striding confidently out of the smoke, armed with a machine gun and a sniper rifle that somehow suit her perfectly, Yuna steps forward with a beaming smile. The Cutie Squad has arrived.

"Today's shopping trip is cancelled. Looks like I've got a city to clean up instead!" With that one cheerful line, an upbeat rock beat kicks in and the real fight begins. Across the city's public displays, the emergency broadcast cuts out, replaced by the glowing logo of the Cutie Squad. And just like that, the girls stride forward like they own the runway, sweeping through the enemy lines and pushing deeper into the heart of the city!
